component.name: YLR-Auto
component.summary: Watch MakeMKV and file finished rips into Jellyfin

description.p: A companion for MakeMKV. It shows what MakeMKV and each optical drive are doing, then files finished rips into Jellyfin libraries using names from TMDb.
Films that match exactly one TMDb entry by name and runtime can be filed automatically. Anything uncertain waits for you, and unattended filing never deletes a file.

screenshot.caption: Finished rips waiting, with TMDb matches, posters and main actors
A large poster shown over the TMDb results

description.p: Says that MakeMKV is needed, and how to get it, when it is absent.

Rewritten in Rust as one program with no Python dependency. It opens faster and uses less memory. A new install follows the desktop's light or dark preference. While ripping, the percentage is in the tray icon's tooltip.
